title: AI-powered BI for Small Businesses: How to Make Informed Decisions with Data | Libra

facts.fact: The article 'AI-powered BI for Small Businesses: How to Make Informed Decisions with Data' was published on September 13, 2023.
facts.quote: How to Make Informed Decisions with Data September 13, 2023

facts.fact: The page presents Business Intelligence as a three-step process: data acquisition, data analysis, and data visualisation.
facts.quote: Understanding Business Intelligence: A Three-Step Process

facts.fact: The page states that there are six crucial steps every business should follow when adopting Business Intelligence.
facts.quote: there are six crucial steps every business should follow

facts.fact: The page attributes to The Data Warehouse Institute (a third party) the definition of Business Intelligence as the processes, technologies, and tools necessary to transform data into information, insights, and action plans.
facts.quote: the processes, technologies, and tools necessary to transform data into information, insights, and action plans
